programs.title: Salaam-E-Ishq
programs.desc: Salaam-e-ishq is a story that weaves six love stories together from different walks of life, in the bustling city of Mumbai. Ignorant about each other's existence, but end up being brought together by destiny, fate and LOVE. Set in the themes of betrayal, love and forgiveness , the film navigates the ups and downs and complexities of the modern relationships.

programs.title: Hostel
programs.desc: Karan, a freshman, goes to live in a hostel and becomes a victim of ragging. After facing severe humiliation, he musters the courage to fight against his perpetrators and also sets out to punish them.

programs.title: Powerful Game
programs.desc: A man unravels the mysteries of his past and his upbringing while settling a village feud.

programs.title: Jai Balaji Mehndipur Wale
programs.desc: The film is based on the famous Jai Balaji Mehandipur Wale temple in Rajasthan
